newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA RAISES MAIN INTEREST RATE TO 48.72 PCT/YR.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA RAISES MAIN INTEREST RATE TO 48.72 PCT/YR.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) will raise its main interest rate to 48.72 percent annually from 43.08 percent, commercial bank dealers said.
"The BNB advised us that it will set its main rate at 48.72 percent annually from Monday," a bank dealer told Reuters.
BNB officials were not immediately available for comment. An official statement could be expected later on Thursday.
Dealers said the new main interest rate would give 61.22 percent effective annual interest rate calculated through the monthly accruals.
The rate hike was in line with rising yields on four-week discount T-bill issues auctioned this week, traders said.
The BNB said last week it would adjust the main rate to the weighted average monthly yield on four-week discount T-bills sold daily from Friday through Thursday.
The average yield to maturity on four-week paper auctioned since Friday ranged between 3.76-3.81 percent, up from 3.55-3.83 percent the week before. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 911 88
